question: Table sugar mostly contains:
solution:
The correct answer is __**sucrose **__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sucrose:**

 
 
• Sucrose is a disaccharide composed of glucose and fructose.
 
• It is the most common type of sugar found in table sugar.
 
• It is extracted from sugarcane or sugar beets.
 
• It is a white crystalline solid.
 
• It is used as a sweetener in many foods and beverages.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Maltose:**

 
 
• Maltose is a disaccharide formed from two glucose molecules.
 
• It is found in malt, which is produced from germinating grains like barley.
 
• It is less sweet than sucrose.
 
• It is used in the production of beer and other malted beverages.
 
• It is also produced when starch breaks down.
 
 
 
• **Fructose:**
 
 
• Fructose is a monosaccharide, also known as fruit sugar.
 
• It is found naturally in fruits, honey, and some vegetables.
 
• It is the sweetest naturally occurring sugar.
 
• It is used as a sweetener in many processed foods and drinks.
 
• High fructose corn syrup is a common industrial sweetener.
 
 
 
• **Glucose:**
 
 
• Glucose is a monosaccharide and a primary source of energy for the body.
 
• It is found in many foods, including fruits, vegetables, and honey.
 
• It is also produced by the body from the breakdown of carbohydrates.
 
• It is a simple sugar.
 
• It is essential for cellular respiration.
